title: Concept: Python requirement pinned to a local version label
description: requirements.txt declares a pin carrying a `+local` version label, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A local label names a build that the public index does not necessarily serve, so the pin resolves only against a specific wheel source.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: A local label names a build that the public index does not necessarily serve, so the pin resolves only against a specific wheel source.
